records.text: A viewer using the handle Lady Lala wrote that a new neighbor bought a rundown house through a Wyoming LLC with nonexistent organizer addresses in New York and West Virginia; the LLC was formed March 4, and the viewer and spouse were searched in Israel on February 19. The identity, year, and claimed search mechanism are unverified.
records.speaker: Lady Lala (viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Lady Lala (viewer handle; real identity unverified) writes, oh my God, my new neighbor bought a rundown house with an LLC registered in Wyoming. The organizers' addresses are in New York and West Virginia, and neither address actually exists. ... The LLC was formed on March 4th, and my husband and I were both searched in Israel on February 19th. I wish you luck.

records.text: And that is not how you unite the country. It's just not how you do it. Lady Lala writes, I know you say that you are not voting anymore, but can we.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
